name: BA Airport Leasehold Real Estate Investment Trust
summary: The BA Airport Leasehold Real Estate Investment Trust, identified by the symbol BAREIT.BK, operates as a specialized real estate investment trust. Its primary focus is on securing long-term lease agreements, key structural elements, and other essential assets integral to the day-to-day functioning of the Samui Airport complex. The company's main office is situated in Chatuchak, Thailand.
